verdict.rationale: monday.com documents several first-party natural-language paths. Users can message, assign items to and @mention agents to kick off work with replies and status updates. They can also describe a workflow in their own words to create an agent, or turn words into work apps with monday vibe. Its hosted MCP and official Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot integrations let users drive monday data from chat assistants. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably; documentation of how many core product operations (board, item and column management) can be done by command; anything beyond marketing-level descriptions.
